findings.conceptual_vs_selectable: MODEL_SLICES names all eight scientific roles. The deployed Senate and House forecast adapters expose only base/electoral history, polling and uncertainty selections. Current House choice and counts/rules are fixed within each complete aggregate result; population, community and participation are unavailable there. A conceptual role is not evidence that the corresponding count provider can be selected.
findings.count_source_state: The owner catalog offers eight research providers for population_cut_v1, including choice candidate_TX_ballot_role_profile_choice_v1. It advertises executable_targets but has saved_presets=[], default_preset_id=null and scheduler_available=false. Its prepared example resolves requires_computation; the package records no actual passing saved count result and exposes no HTTP/UI. Provider availability describes implemented preparation, not an executed fit, saved result, forecast qualification or public release.
findings.house_exact_saved_boundary: HouseLiveCatalog requires exactly 16 2026 aggregate result configurations; HouseLiveControls maps only base, polling and uncertainty and loads an exact saved run ID. Its results and maps are projections of authenticated saved HouseLiveView values, so a count provider ID without an exact count result cannot change charts.
findings.no_provider_id_integration: No reference to candidate_TX_ballot_role_profile_choice_v1 or population_cut_v1 was found in inspected UI lib/components/app/scripts/public data paths. The provider ID currently belongs to the native research catalog only.
findings.seven_instance_study_incompatibility: The component-study server authenticates exactly two historical 2018 aggregate result packets and its resolver requires seven known instances. canonicalStudySelections likewise requires exactly seven providers/selections; result validation is fixed to the 2018 senate_aggregate_logit_empirical_mixture_v1 contract. componentStudySlices uses hard-coded seven legacy instance copy and would dereference missing copy for new count instance IDs. This route cannot directly accept the count driver catalog.
findings.three_slot_gate: The public configurations catalog reads static Senate capabilities.json and the resolve API reads that plus registry.json. The generic resolver explicitly restricts requires_computation metadata to base, polling and uncertainty; ready requires an exact saved, hash-identified configuration. Inserting eight count roles into that existing catalog would not create a valid count forecast.

next_implementation_contract: Obtain an owner-authenticated, versioned count catalog handoff for target population_cut_v1 with eight role offers, provider IDs/versions, default instance IDs, option schemas, source fingerprints, target/output contract and explicit limitations. Preserve native request/configuration identities; do not invent UI options or substitute aggregate provider IDs.

Build a private metadata-only adapter/view using existing MODEL_SLICES and ModelSliceControls for presentation. Display implemented research status separately from execution eligibility, prepared request status, exact saved-result status, and public availability. A prepared selection without a saved result resolves requires_computation; no site scheduling, fit launch, or silent slot coercion.

Use a separate target-specific resolver and server-authenticated catalog rather than widening the three-slot Senate resolver, seven-instance historical component study, or exact-16 House aggregate catalog. Keep source paths and execution bindings server-side.

Enable count results-driven charts only after the owner supplies an exact verified full count ResultRecord and joint artifact plus target-specific browser projection, validation, and separate publication review. Preserve parent/draw/weight and denominator identity; never splice independently fitted components or reuse House aggregate charts as count outputs.
